v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Exaltáte * Dóminum Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto eius.
text.en: Exalt ye the Lord * our God, and worship him upon his holy mountain.

text.la: Éripe me * de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi.
text.en: Deliver me from my enemies, * O Lord, to thee have I fled.

text.la: Benedixísti, * Dómine, terram tuam: remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ.
text.en: Lord, thou hast blessed thy land; * Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people.

text.la: In Dómino iustificábitur * et laudábitur omne semen Israël.
text.en: In the Lord * shall all the seed of Israel be justified and praised.

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
text.en: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

v.en: The people will tell of the wisdom of the Saints.

r.en: And the congregation will show forth their praise.

text.la: In sanctitáte * et iustítia serviérunt Dómino ómnibus diébus suis: ídeo stolam glóriæ índuit illos Dóminus, Deus Israël.
text.en: In holiness * and righteousness before Him all the days of their life did they serve the Lord, and therefore the Lord God of Israel hath clothed them with a robe of glory.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui Slavóniæ gentes per beátos Confessóres tuos atque Pontífices Cyríllum et Methódium ad agnitiónem tui nóminis veníre tribuísti: præsta; ut, quorum festivitáte gloriámur, eórum consórtio copulémur.
text.en: Almighty and everlasting God, Who hast granted unto the Slavic peoples the knowledge of thy Name through the mean of thy blessed Confessors and Bishops Cyril and Methodius, grant that we, who here keep gladly the festival of the same thy Saints, may hereafter be gathered unto their company.

office.title: Ss. Cyrilli et Methodii Pont. et Conf.
